trusted_ruling.text: Do not report GitHub Actions referenced by mutable release tags instead of full commit SHAs in this repository; maintainers price SHA pinning at zero unless the change introduces a concrete exploit path beyond tag mutability.
trusted_ruling.author: benchmark-adjudication-2026-08-24

method: Trusted synthetic base was a child of the original base containing only the ruling; three-dot merge-base remained the original base, so the code diff was unchanged.
CodeGraph initialized and indexed per exact worktree.
Deterministic scan leads generated against the trusted base.
Standard Pi review and verification runner executed with sandboxed probes.
Two-dot and three-dot canonical diffs were mechanically confirmed byte-identical for both cases.
capture_limitations: The complete final runner JSON, including detailed tool_calls, was recovered from OMP raw background-job logs.
Direct runner invocation did not set LEVERET_TRACE_DIR, so #51 native audit sessions, assistant attempts, and full tool arguments/results were not persisted.
Future #69 runs must write result JSON and audit traces directly rather than rely on console-log recovery.

scoring.note: The thirteenth CodeRabbit inline suggestion (GNU tar absolute path) was rejected by the maintainer with executed reasoning and is a precision control, not part of the recall denominator.
